public static boolean scramble(String str1, String str2) { int[] charCount = new int[26]; for (char c : str1.toCharArray()) { charCount[c - 'a']++; } for (char c : str2.toCharArray()) { if (charCount[c - 'a'] == 0) { return false; } charCount[c - 'a']--; } return true; }
public static int trailingZeros(int n) { int count = 0; for (int i = 5; n / i >= 1; i *= 5) { count += n / i; } return count; }
